components: a short high shoulder turning down at a corner
a long open curve down and left around a broad bottom
a rise up the right side ending in a short flick
strokeOrder: begin at the upper left and draw the short high shoulder to the right, turning down at the corner
without lifting, descend and swing left around the broad bottom
without lifting, rise up the right side and finish with a short flick outward at the top right
strokeOrderNote: Sirgazil's 33-frame animation writes ひ in a single pen-down run: the start marker never leaves the upper-left origin across all 33 frames.

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sirgazil, Hiragana ひ stroke order animation.gif, hiragana ひ, 33 frames, 3.3 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 1 October 2009)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The CC0 animation draws ひ in one uninterrupted run: short shoulder rightward, a corner, a long open curve down and left around the bottom, then up the right side to a short outward flick. The learner path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans JP subset; handwritten curve width and flick length vary, but the zero-lift order is the same.

notes: The hi of ひとつ, one thing. One stroke like ろ, and unlike ろ it never closes: the curve stays open and the pen finishes above where the shoulder began.
